# qrcode-generator vendored source

Elistly vendors the browser source distribution of `qrcode-generator` 2.0.4 by Kazuhiko Arase to generate entity QR images entirely on-device.

- Upstream: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator/v/2.0.4
- Source artifact: `qrcode-generator-2.0.4.tgz`
- Artifact SHA-256: `02e2e18a99a90b02dad940851f59b7c3c5fd1ab79cbdece8595cb06328878159`
- `qrcode.js` SHA-256: `79ec86f82856005b1c887905cfccfcfbec3821ca61c7fd5a952faa5f778f791c`
- `qrcode_UTF8.js` SHA-256: `e522d64003b332e29271fdce4993ed3ae2934c8947f41654bd324ddcfa2de301`
- License: MIT

The files are unminified upstream `dist/` sources. They are loaded as static first-party scripts, with no CDN, dynamic import, or remote QR payload URL.
